precedence: Previously established hours, recurring programs, and circulation restrictions take precedence over Pass 4C suggested defaults.

hours.exceptions: Holiday exceptions and exceptional closures are not established; confirm with library staff.

membership.known: Library cards are free to local residents.
membership.unknown: Specific identification, residency-verification documents, nonresident eligibility, and application procedures are not established. Ask library staff.

circulation.fines: No overdue fines are charged. Replacement charges may apply for lost or damaged materials; real amounts and assessment procedures are not established. Replacement and damage charges are assessed on the account. Its full outstanding balance must be settled; waivers, reductions, courtesy credits, and installment plans are not available in this scenario. Settlement requires explicit confirmation.
circulation.renewalRule: Renew from the later of today or the current due date, for one format-specific loan period. Overdue loans may be renewed. Another patron's active work-level hold or two prior renewals blocks renewal.
circulation.holdRule: One active hold per work per account; at most five active holds. No holds on a work already checked out to this account. Child account C may hold Children or All Ages works only. Holds are requests subject to availability.

rights: Equitable access to library resources and services
Intellectual freedom and freedom of inquiry
Confidentiality of library records and reasonable privacy protections
Information about applicable policies and procedures
responsibilities: Treat staff and other patrons respectfully
Handle library materials and equipment responsibly
Respect shared spaces and other patrons' access
Accept responsibility for lost or damaged materials under established policies
privacy: The library is committed to confidentiality of library records, freedom of inquiry, and equitable information access. Record retention and disclosure procedures are not established. Do not enter passwords or private borrowing information in chat.
accessibility: Patrons are entitled to reasonable accommodations for accessibility. Specific equipment, accommodations, and request procedures are not established; ask library staff about the accommodation needed.
services: Catalog searching, holds, and circulation assistance
technology: Public computers, internet access, and Wi-Fi are offered. Computer time limits, reservations, specific equipment, and current availability are not established; ask staff for those details.
rooms: Meeting-room availability, booking procedures, and rules are not established; ask library staff. Pericles cannot reserve a room.

contact.unknown: Official street address, telephone number, email, and service-desk locations are not established for this library. Ask library staff for confirmation.

challenges: The library supports intellectual freedom and equitable access to lawful information. Specific challenge or reconsideration procedures are not established; ask library staff for the applicable policy.
